title: Deepotsav Din 3 · Lakshmi Puja
name: KathaDeep_Deepotsav_Din3_Lakshmi
caption:
Lakshmi ji ek baar swarg chhodkar chali gayi thin… jaante hain kyun? 🪔

Deepotsav · Din 3/5 — aaj Badi Diwali, Lakshmi Puja.
Vishnu Puran (1.9): Durvasa ki divya maala Indra ne Airavat ke sir par rakh di, haathi ne zameen par phenk di — aur swarg se Shri chali gayin.
Bhagavat Puran (8.8): manthan se prakat hokar Lakshmi ji ne har dev, har rishi ko dekha — kisi mein tap tha par krodh nahi jeeta, kisi mein gyaan tha par moh nahi chhoota — aur chuna Vishnu ko, jinhe unse kuch nahi chahiye tha.

Lakshmi ahankaar ke ghar mein nahi tiktin. Wahan rehti hain, jahan sammaan hai.
Aapko aur aapke parivaar ko Shubh Deepavali! 🙏
Kal: Din 4 · Govardhan.

Sources: Vishnu Purana 1.9; Bhagavata Purana 8.8. Art: The Met, Open Access (CC0).

title: Kuber · Part 3 (finale)
name: KathaDeep_Kuber_Part3
cover: KUBER KE BETE PED KYUN BANE?
caption:
Kuber ke do bete… devtaon jaise ameer. Aur phir ek din — dono ped ban gaye. 🌳🌳

Kuber ki kahani ka Part 3 (finale). Bhagavat Puran (10.10): Nalakubar aur Manigriv, dhan ke nashe mein — Devarshi Narad ka shraap: "ped ban jao", par saath mein kripa: ek din Bhagwan khud mukt karenge.
Gokul mein Nand Baba ke aangan ke do arjun ke ped… aur ek din ookhli se bandhe Kanha ne unhe jad se ukhaad diya. Isiliye Krishna kahlaye — DAMODAR. (10.9)

Aaj Lakshmi-Kuber puja par seekh: dhan ke saath vinamrata.
Part 1 (Sone ki Lanka) aur Part 2 (Ravan ka shraap) profile par hain.
Agli kahani kaunsi chahiye? Comment kijiye 👇

Sources: Bhagavata Purana 10.9–10.10. Art: The Met, Open Access (CC0).

title: Tamaso Ma Jyotirgamaya
name: KathaDeep_Tamaso_Ma_Jyotirgamaya
caption:
Aaj Amavasya hai — aasmaan mein chaand bilkul nahi. Aur phir bhi, aaj ki raat saal ki sabse roshan raat. 🪔

Hazaron saal purana ek mantra, Brihadaranyaka Upanishad (1.3.28) se:
असतो मा सद्गमय।
तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय।
मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय।
Asatya se satya ki or. Andhere se roshni ki or. Mrityu se amrit ki or.

Diwali ka poora arth, bas in teen panktiyon mein. Aaj jab diya jalayein, ye mantra zaroor boliye.
Shubh Deepavali! 🙏 Is reel ko apne parivaar ke group mein bhejiye.

Source: Brihadaranyaka Upanishad 1.3.28. Art: The Met, Open Access (CC0).
